message.Title: Public Preview: Markdown for Agents in Azure App Service

Body.Content:
Today, we are announcing the public preview of Markdown for Agents in Azure App Service. This feature gives AI agents and other tools a cleaner way to consume content from an App Service app. When a client requests Markdown, App Service can automatically convert the app's HTML response to Markdown without requiring changes to the application code. 

Learn more.
